name: Pinewatch Hunter
title: On the Cull
examine: Quiet boots, patched leathers, and a tally string on the belt with fewer knots in it than last year. They have noticed. They do not talk about it.
lines: The count is the count. Kolbrun writes it, the wood checks it.
You walk loud. Everything north of the wall already knows your name.
Wolves first, then boar, then whatever the winter sends. There is always a then.
